color.$description: SEMANTIC color tokens — LIGHT mode (Lumen v0.12). Mode parity required: same key paths exist in color.dark.tokens.json with different values. Light mode is the inverse of the v0.12 neutral obsidian dark mode: clean paper-white + neutral obsidian ink + the same spring-green accent. v0.11 retired the warm-cream paper canvas in favor of cool-neutral paper, anchored to the user-fixed light value (#E6E6E6) used as subtle borders / sunken surfaces. v0.12 stripped the residual +1 G channel drift from the neutral ramp's mid-stops so the light mode is fully neutral end-to-end.

page.$description: Paper canvas #FAFAFA — clean off-white. v0.12 — fully neutral (the v0.11 'whisper of warmth' was 0.4% above neutral; v0.12 normalizes the full neutral ramp). Replaces v0.10 cream paper #fdfcf7.

raised.$description: Cards, panels, raised surfaces. Pure white pops above paper canvas. v0.11.13 — references {color.absolute.white}.

sunken.$description: Inputs, table-row hover, sidebar — anchored to user-fixed #E6E6E6.

glass.$description: Floating glass shell — pair with backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%). v0.11.13 — references {color.alpha.paper.72}.

inverse.$description: Dark surface for contrast moments in light mode (CTA bands, footers).

tint-accent.$description: Spring-green tint for hover / selection backgrounds.

input.$description: v0.6 — input field surfaces (light mode). Uses sunken neutral so the field reads as inset on the paper canvas.

rest.$description: Sunken neutral — inset feel against paper. v0.11 anchored to user-fixed #E6E6E6.

focus.$description: Pop to paper-white on focus — cognitive-fluency cue: 'you have my attention'. v0.11.13 — references {color.absolute.white}.

primary.$description: Body and titles — #141615. Contrast 17.2:1 on paper canvas.

placeholder.$description: Input placeholder. AA-safe at 14px+. Distinct alias from tertiary so it can theme independently.

accent.$description: Spring-green text on light surfaces. 4.6:1 on paper — AA at 14px+.

error.$description: v0.6 — error text on light surface. Deep red for AA.

success.$description: v0.6 — success text. Deep accent for AA.

warning.$description: v0.6 — warning text. Deep amber for AA.

hairline.$description: Default hairline. Cards, table rows, dividers. The breathing-room separator (per principles §1, §3).

accent.$description: Accent hairline (deeper green for AAA on light)

focus.$description: Focus ring color (light mode). v0.13.1 bump from accent.500 → accent.800 (#008A4D) to clear the WCAG 2.4.13 advisory: accent.500 on paper resolves to 1.34:1, accent.700 resolves to 2.72:1 (still below the 3:1 floor), accent.800 resolves to 4.16:1 — clearing the floor with margin. Production CSS layers a 2px outline + alpha-32 halo so the rendered ring exceeds the floor further. Always paired with shadow.focus. Dark mode keeps accent.400 (border.focus is composed in color.dark.tokens.json).

error.$description: v0.6 — input error border. Refined red for AA stroke contrast.

success.$description: v0.6 — input success border. Spring green; only after explicit validation.

warning.$description: v0.6 — input warning border. Refined amber.

disabled.$description: v0.6 — input disabled border. Muted; no hover/focus.

fg.$description: Near-black-mint #07120D on spring green — 14.7:1 AAA. Single-source for both themes.

tertiary.$description: v0.9 alias of ghost — kept for backwards compatibility.

ghost.$description: v0.9 — neutral × ghost. No chrome at rest, subtle hover tint.

outline.$description: v0.9 — hairline pill / rect (transparent fill + 1px ink hairline). Neutral × outline surface.

danger.$description: v0.11 — danger CTA. bg deepened red.500→.700 to clear WCAG AA Normal.

danger-soft.$description: v0.9 — danger × ghost. Carbon's `danger-ghost` pattern. v0.11.13 — bg.hover/press now reference {color.alpha.danger.08}/{14} primitives.

ai.$description: v0.9 — AI-action variant. Spring-green tonal + sparkle leading icon. Sparingly applied.

fg.$description: Deep accent on neutral — 4.6:1 AA pass.

selected.$description: v0.9 — aria-pressed=true state for ToggleButton / Segmented option.

glass.$description: v0.9 — translucent surface for floating overlays. Light mode keeps a paper-tinted glass. v0.11.13 — hover/press now reference {color.alpha.paper.84}/{94} primitives.

neutral.$description: v0.11.15 — neutral status pill bg + fg in light mode. Light mode mirror of the dark fix; raised cream backgrounds already gave neutral pills sufficient contrast pre-v0.11.15, so the value is unchanged in this mode. Declared here for mode parity with the dark token tree.

bg.$description: Raised neutral surface #F1F2F1 — 16.5:1 on cream-9 ink (AAA).

aurora.$description: Radial spring-green ambient glow — softer in light mode (paper canvas carries less contrast headroom).
